narrative.intro: Massachusetts Institute of Technology has federal contract obligations of $1.2B for FY2026 to date. Massachusetts Institute of Technology received 28 awards so far. Massachusetts Institute of Technology shows an average award size of $43.4M, and obligations are down 15.8% year over year. Massachusetts Institute of Technology ranked obligations across fiscal years as follows: FY21 $1.1B, FY22 $1.1B, FY23 $1.4B, FY24 $1.5B, FY25 $1.4B, FY26 $1.2B. Massachusetts Institute of Technology sells mainly in research markets, led by Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) at $1B and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $175M. Massachusetts Institute of Technology current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and figures are contract obligations except where tables list total contract values for largest awards and expiring contracts.

sections.heading: How does revenue this year compare to prior years?
sections.body: Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligated $1.2B in FY2026 to date, down 15.8% year over year. Massachusetts Institute of Technology previously obligated $1.4B in FY25 and $1.5B in FY24. Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligations were $1.4B in FY23 and $1.1B in both FY21 and FY22.

sections.heading: What markets and contract sizes dominate the work?
sections.body: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the largest market at $1B. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) is the second market at $175M. Massachusetts Institute of Technology has an average award size of $43.4M across 28 awards.
